strings.(정확히 언제인지 알 수 없는 시간의 틈, 그 사이.): (Somewhere between the cracks of time, at a moment impossible to place precisely.)
It's not as though anyone told you to accept so many requests, Captain...
Callone, call me your esteemed captain.
strings.좋아. 의뢰 안 받으면 용병단 운영을 어떻게 하라고?: Good. How am I supposed to run the mercenary company without taking jobs?
strings.목표치에서 많이 부족합니까?: Are we far short of the target?
strings.실바리아 최고 부자 라슈르 정도 되어야 하지 않을까?: About as much as Lashur, the richest man in Silvaria, perhaps?
strings.그 정도면 몇 번을 다시 태어나고 하루도 쉬지 않고 일해도 불가능할 것: That sounds impossible even if we were reborn several times and worked every day without rest...
It's a figure of speech. Come on, let's find a cat.
Is it a real cat this time? Last time you said cat, you meant the princess.
strings.시이나는 사랑스러운 아기 고양이 맞거든. 자, 자, 일단 제일 급한 의뢰: Shiina is an adorable little kitten. Now, now. Let's look at the most urgent request first. Yes, a cat. Meow.
strings.「얼마 전, 집에 와 보니 사랑스러운 내 아이들이 사라졌습니다. 까칠한: 「A little while ago, I came home to find my beloved little ones missing: 'Mungchi,' a prickly gray cat, and 'Potato,' a round, medium-sized dog.」
strings.「둘은 지금 넥타르 서커스장에 들어가서 나오지 않고 있습니다. 」: 「The two have entered the Nectar Circus and will not come out.」
strings.넥타르 서커스장, 기억나. 두목이 그 공연을 보여 줘서 너무 행복했거든…: I remember the Nectar Circus. The boss took me to a performance, and I was so happy...
I've never seen it, but I understand it's quite famous.
strings.「제 힘으로 데려올 수 없어서 이렇게 용병단에 의뢰를 드립니다.」: 「I cannot bring them back myself, so I am submitting this request to your mercenary company.」
strings.자기 힘으로 데려올 수 없어서 용병단에게 의뢰할 정도면 서커스장이 꽤 위: If they need mercenaries because they can't get them back themselves, the circus must be rather dangerous.
Captain, you've been calling %s to help find cats...?
strings.의뢰가 많을 때만 그랬어. %s도 괜찮다고 했고. 그렇지, %s? 빨리: Only when we had too many requests. %s said it was fine too. Right, %s? Hurry and say it's fine.
%s, anyway, you've come at the right time. Let's handle this together.
strings.마침 한가하니까요. 그런데 넥타르 서커스장이 어디 있는지 아세요?: I happen to be free. But do you know where the Nectar Circus is?
strings.얼마 전 글래스턴을 다녀온 쥬빌이 그러는데, 대륙 투어를 마치고 다시 글: Jubil recently visited Glaston. She says the circus finished its continental tour and returned there.
Don't worry. It'll be fine. %s is with us too.
strings.결국 %s에게 다 맡기실 생각 아닌지요?: You aren't planning to leave everything to %s, are you?
No, we'll all solve it together.
strings.고양이랑 강아지를 데려오는 일인데, 큰일이야 생기겠어요?: We're just bringing back a cat and a dog. What could go seriously wrong?
Jubil needs to return to Glaston too, so let's all go together. Hehe.
strings.단장님, 글래스턴으로 가는 게 그렇게 좋습니까?: Captain, are you that happy about going to Glaston?
Yes. We're going as a group. I'm so excited my heart is fluttering.
strings.이것만 마시고 따로 움직일까요? 아직 우리 자유롭지도 않잖아요. 여기에: Shall we finish these drinks and split up? We still aren't entirely free to act. There's a famous adventurer here too, and plenty of eyes on us. All right?
Well, our friend did save Eastland from destruction.
strings.영웅은 아니에요. 다른 분들이 훨씬 대단하죠. 그런데 쥬빌은 어디 가는: I'm no hero. The others are much more impressive. Where are you going, Jubil?
strings.보석 도감을 만드는 쥬얼스타를 만나기로 했어요. 저희 집안에서 방치한 보: I'm meeting Jewelstar, who compiles a jewel encyclopedia. My family has an abandoned gem mine, and I'm going to take Jewelstar there.
strings.거기서 원하는 게 나오면 이만큼 주겠다고 했어요. 단장님이 하는 일에 어: If we find what's needed, I've been promised this much. It should help with what the captain is doing.
strings.단원들이 있는 곳에서 전부 이야기했잖아요. 비밀이라고 하기에는 너무 많은: You told everyone when the company was together. Too many people know for it to be a secret...
strings.생각보다 대륙에 나와 비슷한 아이들이 많아서 말이야. 그런 아이들이 별: There are more children like me on the continent than I expected. I'm thinking of creating a place that helps them grow up safely...
...It's a good thing, but please don't overextend yourself...
I'll be going, then. Don't cry because you miss me.
strings.우리도 가자. 어디에 있다고 했지?: Let's go too. Where did they say it was?
strings.꽃 파는 청년에게 물어보니 얼마 전에 라슈에트 거리에 서커스 천막이 들어: I asked the young flower seller. He said a circus tent went up on LaChouette Street recently.
Apparently it's quite large, so it should be easy to find.
strings.칼로네, 우리 서커스 공연도 보고 가자!: Callone, let's watch the circus while we're there!
We didn't come for fun, but... A little while should be fine.
strings.(나, 그러고 보니 서커스 같은 걸 제대로 본 적이 없네…. 한번 살펴볼: (Come to think of it, I've never really watched a circus... Shall I have a look?)
I've never had a part-time job like this. I'm nervous.
%s? I never expected to see you here... Good to see you.
%s, what's with that man? Horns...? Don't tell me...
Oh, young lady, can you see my horns? I thought the Order's priests had taken care of that.
He lives in Invernel... Oh, how much should I explain?
strings.뭘 그렇게 고민하나. 하하, 나는 인버넬에서 아르바이트를 하러 내려온 로: Why think so hard? Haha. I'm Romalius, down from Invernel for a part-time job.
strings.인버넬에서 알바하러 여기까지? 너무 멀지 않아?: All the way from Invernel for a job? Isn't that awfully far?
strings.칼로네, 저분 머리 위에 있는 거 보여?: Callone, can you see what's on his head?
strings.설마 머리 위에 영혼 고리 같은 게 있습니까?: Don't tell me he has some sort of spirit halo?
If Callone can't see it, other people probably can't either.
strings.저기, 로말리우스, 혹시 교단의 허가를 받고 나온 건가요?: Romalius, did you get the Order's permission to come here?
strings.당연하지. 마을 대표와 교단의 허락과 함께 사제들이 달려들어 뿔이 안 보: Of course. With permission from the village representative and the Order, the priests all rushed in to cast something that would hide my horns.
strings.모두가 나의 자립을 도우려는 모습에 매우 감동했어. 그래서 내가 여기까지: I was deeply moved that everyone wanted to help me become independent. That's how I was able to come all this way.
Though the scenery was so beautiful that I nearly got lost.
strings.무슨 알바를 하러 여기까지 온 거예요?: What kind of job brought you here?
strings.생전 처음 보는 사제 하나가 마수 알렉산드라와 제니퍼를 찾아 달라고 하더: A priest I'd never seen before asked me to find the demonic beasts Alexandra and Jennifer.
strings.아저씨가 말하는 그 마수, 여기 있어?: Are those beasts you're talking about here, mister?
strings.소녀는 날 평범한 인간 아저씨로 대하는 것 같은데, 맘에 들어. 기분이다: You seem to treat me like an ordinary human man, young lady. I like that. I'm in a good mood, so I'll answer.
strings.내가 마력을 잃었어도 마수의 냄새 정도는 조금 맡을 수 있거든. 저기 보: Even without my magic, I can still smell demonic beasts a little. See over there? I can faintly smell them inside.
strings.알렉산드라와 제니퍼라니, 대체 어떤 녀석들이지? 형이 키우는 그런 것들인: Alexandra and Jennifer... What sort of creatures are they? Like the ones my brother keeps?
strings.성격 나쁜 형이라도 마수들에게는 애정을 잔뜩 주거든. 주인에게 버려진 마: My brother has a terrible temper, but he showers the beasts with affection. He takes in abandoned ones, walks them four hours a day, and plays with them.
What on earth am I listening to...?
Ahaha. Callone, let it go in one ear and out the other.
strings.저기, 로말리우스, 그래서 그 마수를 어떻게 하려고요?: Romalius, what do you intend to do with those beasts?
strings.지금 내 힘으로는 제압하는 것도 힘들고, 데려갈 수도 없어. 그냥 확인하: With my current strength, I can neither subdue them nor take them away. I'll just confirm they're here and return. The client said he'd handle the rest.
strings.힘이 좀 있으면 제압해서 추가로 위험 수당을 받을 수 있을 텐데, 괜히: If I had a little strength, I could subdue them and collect extra hazard pay. What a shame.
strings.의뢰를 받았어요. 여기 갇혀서 나오지 못한다는 고양이와 강아지가 있어서요: We took a request. A cat and dog are apparently trapped inside and can't get out.
strings.아저씨, 우리는 온 김에 서커스 공연도 볼 거야. 물론 고양이와 강아지를: Mister, while we're here, we're going to watch the circus too. After we find the cat and dog, of course.
strings.연기자들이 나와서 묘기를 선보이고, 사람 잘 따르는 동물들이 나와서 춤도: Performers come out and do tricks, and tame animals dance.
strings.오, 신기하군. 혹시 그런 걸 보는 데 돈이 드는가?: Oh, how fascinating. Does it cost money to watch?
You have to buy a ticket.
I'll just do my job and head back, then.
strings.아저씨, 우리 같이 들어갈까? 우리는 강아지랑 고양이 찾고, 아저씨는 마: Why don't we go in together? We'll find the cat and dog, and you can check whether the beasts are there.
Let's leave all the dangerous parts to %s.
strings.저기요, 제 의견은 안 들어 보시나요?: Excuse me. Does anyone want to hear my opinion?
The circus's interior is quite splendid.
strings.천막 안이 이렇게 넓을 줄이야. 이렇게 넓은 곳에서 어떻게 강아지와 고양: I never thought the tent would be this spacious. How will we find a cat and dog in such a huge place?
strings.보기보다 규모가 큰 공연장이야. 마수가 수십 마리 날뛰어도 끄떡없을 것: The venue is larger than it looks. It seems as though dozens of demonic beasts could rampage without damaging it...
strings.그러면 이름 부르며 찾아볼까요?: Shall we call their names as we search?
You two. Shh. Wait a moment.
strings.일이 잘못된 건 아니겠죠?: Something hasn't gone wrong, has it?
That's Callone for you. So quick to catch on.
strings.다른 건 모르겠지만, 이상하다는 건 알아. 지금 보이는 풍경이 일반적인: I don't know much, but I know it's strange. What we're seeing is thousands, tens of thousands of times larger than an ordinary tent.
strings.누군가가 인위적으로 만든 공간 같아. 아무래도 여기서 계획을 변경해야겠어: It seems to be an artificially created space. We'd better change our plan.
strings.%s 말고 거기 두 사람, 목숨 소중하지?: You two, apart from %s. You value your lives, don't you?
strings.(로말리우스가 큰 소리로 마수의 이름을 부르자 일행이 있는 공간이 흔들린: (When Romalius loudly calls the beasts' names, the space around the group trembles.)
strings.두 사람은 나가는 편이 좋겠어. 내 눈에는 %s보다 두 사람이 마수의 간: You two should leave. To my eyes, you look much more suitable as beast snacks than %s does.
strings.무슨 그런 말씀을 웃으시면서 하십니까?: How can you say that with a smile?
Captain, let's leave. Money is good, but life comes first.
If you say so, Callone. All right, we'll leave.
%s. Let's go on, just the two of us.
strings.저도 목숨이 소중한데요…?: I value my life too, you know...?
You can handle a few dozen demonic beasts easily.
Hehe. Don't be shy. Find Mungchi and Potato for us.
This place seems designed so that once you leave, you can't enter again...
strings.로말리우스, 고양이하고 강아지는 어떻게 하죠?: Romalius, what about the cat and dog?
Call their names loudly. Go on.
(The circus suddenly shakes far more violently than when the beasts' names were called. An ear-splitting roar follows.)
I think Mungchi the cat and Potato the dog are the demonic beasts Alexandra and Jennifer...
We have you here, %s, so we should catch them.
strings.찾는다는 게 퇴치까지 한다는 거였어요?: Since when did finding them include defeating them?
strings.보통 마수 확인보다 퇴치 쪽이 현상금이 더 나오잖아. 겸사겸사 %s 덕: Defeating beasts usually earns a bigger bounty than confirming their location. Let me benefit from your skills while we're here, %s.
strings.지금 안 잡으면 이 마수가 바깥으로 도망가서 날뛸지 몰라. 여신님한테 해: If we don't catch them now, they might escape and rampage outside. We can't let them harm the goddess's cause, can we?
Ugh... All right. Let's catch them.
strings.좋아. 내가 가면서 애들 이름 불러 줄게. 그러면 금방 찾을 수 있을 거: Good. I'll call their names as we go. That should help us find them quickly.
This is the only place left where Mungchi could be.
strings.감자라고 했던 '곰', 그냥 일반 마족 같던데…. 왜 마수라고 불렸을까요: That 'bear' called Potato seemed like an ordinary demon... Why was it called a demonic beast? And why a dog?
strings.날 보고 '배신자' 라고 하는 걸 보면 지능도 있고, 말도 하는 마족이지: It called me a traitor, so it's an intelligent, speaking demon. Neither a beast nor a dog...
strings.복잡하게 생각하지 말자고. 그런 놈들 여기 있어 봐야 사람들에게 위협이: Let's not overthink it. Creatures like those are a threat to people as long as they're here.
strings.쓰러뜨려서 나오는 물건 같은 건 내가 좀 챙겨도 괜찮지?: Do you mind if I take some of the things they drop when defeated?
strings.네, 괜찮아요. 그런데 어디에 쓰려고요?: That's fine. What will you use them for?
strings.상점에 팔아서 살림에 보태 쓰려고. 자, 이번에는 뭉치를 쓰러뜨려 보자고: I'll sell them to help with living expenses. Now, let's defeat Mungchi.
strings.아까 그 마족, '감자'라고 부르니까 엄청나게 싫어했었죠?: That demon really hated being called 'Potato,' didn't it?
strings.그럴 수밖에. 수인 출신 마족들은 동물 취급당하는 거 엄청나게 싫어하거든: Of course. Demons who were once beastfolk hate being treated like animals. Many crossed into the Demon Realm and became demons for that very reason.
strings.그런 마족에게 펫 같은 이름을 붙인 자가 있다면 특이하거나 그들보다 더: If someone gave such demons pet names, that person must be unusual or stronger than they are...
strings.그러고 보니 제니퍼라는 이름도 싫어했지. 제니퍼가 뭐 어때서. 잘 어울리: Come to think of it, it hated Jennifer too. What's wrong with Jennifer? It suited it.
Oh, then if we call Mungchi 'Alexandra'...
strings.(주위를 살피는 %s의 앞으로 뭔가가 커다란 소리를 내며 떨어진다. 조용: (Something falls with a tremendous noise before %s as you scan the surroundings. Looking ahead, you see a crumpled steel beam that had supported the circus.)
strings.감히 날 가두고 내게 그런 이름을 붙이다니!: How dare you imprison me and give me such a name!
strings.내 이름은 스카라, 마계의 긍지 높은 전사다. 귀여운 털 뭉치도 아니고: My name is Scara, proud warrior of the Demon Realm! Not a cute ball of fluff, and not the beautiful Alexandra!! Huh?
strings.배신자 로말리우스? 네가 어떻게 여기 있지?: Romalius the traitor? What are you doing here?
strings.마계 주민들을 살해하고 도망간 고위 마족을 모른다면 말이 안 되지. 크르: Who wouldn't know the high-ranking demon who murdered Demon Realm residents and fled? Grrrr.
strings.그들은 가만히 있는 날 죽이겠다고 달려들었어. 그래서 방어했을 뿐인데 그: They attacked me, threatening to kill me when I was doing nothing. I only defended myself. How is that murder?
strings.안 그래도 캐릭터 소개에는 '뭉치'라고 나갔을 거야. 지금 말풍선에도 그: Your character introduction probably already says 'Mungchi.' And that's what the speech bubble says right now too.
strings.로말리우스, 그게 무슨 소리예요?: Romalius, what are you talking about?
strings.왠지 이 상황에서는 이런 말을 해야 할 것 같아서. 그래도 넌 감자 제니: Somehow, it felt like the right thing to say here. Still, you have more dialogue than Potato Jennifer.
strings.감자 제니퍼? 설마 라이카를 말하는 건가? 라이카는 지금 어디에 있지?: Potato Jennifer? Do you mean Laika? Where is Laika now?
My friend here defeated him on the way in.
You're the one who told me to attack first, Romalius.
Splendid work, just what I'd expect from %s, whose name is known in the Demon Realm.
And you kept making the defeated Potato drink holy water.
strings.마족에게 명복을 빌어 주는 것만큼 좋은 일이 어디 있겠어. 성수를 쓰면: What could be better than praying for a demon's soul? Holy water should help it reach a better place rather quickly.
strings.라이카를…. 감히 라이카를…. 크르르르!: Laika... How dare you do that to Laika... Grrrr!
strings.그건 그렇고, 너희들은 왜 여기에 있지?: By the way, why are you here?
strings.배신자에게는 털끝만큼도 이야기할 생각이 없다. 정 듣고 싶다면 날 쓰러뜨: I won't tell a traitor so much as a whisker of information. If you insist on hearing it, defeat me first. Grrrr!!
strings.(뭉치가 큰 소리를 내자 서커스 공연장 내부가 흔들린다.): (As Mungchi roars, the circus interior shakes.)
A ball of fluff refusing even a whisker of information. How fitting...
%s, I'll leave this to you. I'll hide back there.
Sigh. All right. I suppose we'll have to defeat him before we hear why...
Scara, proud warrior of the Demon Realm, beaten by a human like this...
strings.네가 진 게 당연해. 이 사람은 보통 인간이 아니거든. 여신님의 사람이야: Of course you lost. This is no ordinary human. This is the goddess's follower.
strings.너희, 마계에서 왜 여기로 온 거야?: Why did you come here from the Demon Realm?
Mungchi Alexandra Scara. Tell us why you came, as promised.
To wipe out the humans and place Etoile beneath the demons' feet...
How predictable. It doesn't look like Barbatos sent you. Lux again, I suppose.
Lord Lux did not order this. We came to earn distinction and become legion commanders...
strings.%s, 얘 어떻게 할까? 감자처럼 만들까?: %s, what shall we do with him? The same as Potato?
strings.(뭉치가 피를 토하며 버티려 하지만, 다가오는 고통에 그대로 정신을 잃고: (Mungchi coughs blood and tries to hold on, but the approaching pain overwhelms him. He loses consciousness and collapses.)
We'll have to leave him. Mungchi Alexandra Scara will die like this. Whoever imprisoned him probably never intended to let him live.
strings.인간인 너는 느끼지 못하겠지만, 이 공간에는 마계에서 최고로 손꼽히는 독: You're human, so you can't sense it, but this space is filled with the scent of Cantarella, one of the Demon Realm's most potent poisons.
It seems modified to kill only demons.
strings.예전에 형이 우리를 공격하는 놈들을 쫓으려고 칸타렐라를 대량으로 만든 적: My brother once made large quantities of Cantarella to drive off our attackers. Back then, I drank it with the Order's holy water to build resistance.
strings.뭐, 내성이 생겼는지는 모르겠지만, 덕분에 마력이 사라져서 여기서 괜찮은: Well, I don't know if I gained resistance, but it did strip away my magic. Perhaps that's why I'm all right here.
strings.괜찮다면 다행이지만, 이제 의뢰는 어떻게 하죠…?: I'm glad you're all right, but what about our requests...?
strings.그러게. 얘네들이 고양이와 강아지도 아니고, 돈을 받을 수 있는 마수도: Good point. They aren't a cat and dog, or beasts we can collect payment for...
It can't be helped. We'll have to report that the jobs failed.
strings.이 공간에 대해서는 너무 걱정하지 마. 우리도 나가면 다시 들어올 수 없: Don't worry too much about this space. Once we leave, we won't be able to enter again either.
strings.너무 복잡하게 생각하지 마. 그러다 보면 할 수 있는 아르바이트도 없다고: Don't overthink things. Do that, and there won't be any part-time jobs you can take. Now, shall we go?
strings.(복잡하게 생각하지 않으려고 해도 찜찜하네….): (Even if I try not to overthink it, something feels wrong...)
strings.후아, 밖이다. 칸타렐라 향은 언제 맡아도 별로란 말이지. 어, 이상하네: Whew, outside. I never like the smell of Cantarella. Huh, strange. The smell hasn't gone away even out here.
Just a passing demon... I mean, you've got the wrong person.
Did you feed Hellfire before leaving? One of them has separation anxiety, remember?
Of course. I fed them and walked them, so they'll be fine for a few hours.
Andrea, why are you here? Tell us properly.
strings.어쩔 수 없군. 정체를 들켰으니 말해주지. 도망간 놈들을 잡으러 왔을 뿐: It can't be helped. You've recognized me, so I'll explain. I only came to catch the runaways. I'll take them back through Lysithea's Gate.
Oh, Potato Jennifer Laika and Mungchi Alexandra Scara.
Grrrr. I told you not to call us that.
strings.쿠오오오…. 안드레아, 우리에게 성수를 퍼붓고 죽이려고 했던 녀석들과 한: Rooooar... Andrea, are you with the ones who poured holy water over us and tried to kill us?
Oh, neither of you died. You nearly died at %s's hands.
strings.이름이 뭐라고 했지? 감자, 뭉치? 여기서 죽고 싶지 않으면 조용히 해라: What were your names? Potato and Mungchi? If you don't want to die here, be quiet. Potato-Mungchi!
strings.리시테아의 문이 여기 어디에 연결된 거야?: Where around here does Lysithea's Gate connect?
Anyway. I have no intention of causing trouble here. Move aside.
strings.한 가지만 묻지. 감자뭉치가 왜 여기 있지?: One question. Why are Potato-Mungchi here?
strings.이야기를 들어 보니 여기 서커스 단장이란 인간이 이놈들을 마족이 아니라: From what I heard, the human circus director mistook them for large animals instead of demons and lured them with food.
strings.긍지 높은 마족이라는 놈들이 그깟 사료에 넘어가다니 우습군. 그런 사료라: How laughable for supposedly proud demons to be won over by mere feed. I can give them more than enough of that.
strings.감자, 아니, 라이카! 넘어가지 마라!: Potato... I mean, Laika! Don't fall for it!
strings.충성을 다하겠습니다. 안드레아 님!: I pledge my loyalty, Lord Andrea!
strings.그건 리시테아의 문에 들어가서 하는 걸 보고 판단하겠다. 그래도 벨리알: I'll judge that by your behavior once we're inside Lysithea's Gate. Still, it should be easier than serving Belial.
strings.아, 벨리알 밑에 있었어? 그러면 이해해. 저기 안드레아, 내게 제니퍼와: Oh, you were under Belial? Then I understand. Andrea, do you know the priest who asked me to look for Jennifer and Alexandra?
That elf priest? Something about the youngest fifth-rank...
strings.리시테아의 문이 열려 있어서 닫으려고 갔더니 웬 엘프 사제 하나가 안을: Lysithea's Gate was open, so I went to close it. Some elf priest was peering inside, and our eyes met.
strings.실적이 모자라다느니, 거래에 응하지 않으면 인생을 엉망으로 만들어 주겠다: He went on about falling short of his quota, and how he'd ruin my life if I refused a deal.
strings.덤벼 보라고 했더니 전투 사제 부대를 잔뜩 데려오더군. 강제로 문을 열고: I told him to try me, and he brought a whole force of battle priests. They tried to force the gate open and purify the inside, so I had no choice but to agree.
If I fail to protect that place while Lux's binding remains...
strings.…형제 싸움은 나중에 하고, 그 거래라는 게 뭐야?: ...Save the brotherly quarrel for later. What was the deal?
strings.…안에 있는 문 하나를 떼서 달라는 것이다. 교단 사원 기도실 문 하나가: ...He wanted me to remove one of the doors inside and give it to him. A prayer-room door at the Order's temple was broken and needed replacing. As though all doors were the same.
Then he told me to take these two away myself. Said he'd already taken suitable measures...
strings.서커스 단장이 어떤 인간인지 모르겠지만, 이놈들을 잘도 구속했군. 그뿐이: I don't know what kind of human that circus director is, but he certainly bound these fools well. That's all. Finished.
Then you may kill me here.
%s, we should let him go. He isn't lying.
And here come your two friends.
strings.두 분 여기 계셨군요. 뭐, 이, 이거 뭡니까?: There you both are. Wh-What is all this?
strings.얘네도 감자와 뭉치야?: Are these Potato and Mungchi too?
(As Potato and Mungchi begin to snarl at the humans, Andrea raises a hand.)
strings.앉겠습니다. 안드레아 님! 너도 앉아. 다시 벨리알 밑으로 갈 생각이야?: I'll sit, Lord Andrea! You sit too. Do you want to go back to Belial?
You won't see me again, little brother.
strings.(안드레아가 어디선가 거대한 문짝을 꺼내 서커스장 앞에 세우고는, 그 문: (Andrea produces an enormous door from somewhere, sets it in front of the circus, opens it, and takes Potato and Mungchi through.)
strings.와, 신기하다. 저것도 서커스 공연의 일부인가? 들어갔다고 바로 사라지네: Wow, amazing. Is that part of the circus too? It vanished as soon as they went in.
I don't think so. That was...
Let's go too. We found Potato and Mungchi, after all.
Their owner must cherish them greatly. We received quite a large sum.
strings.진짜 강아지와 고양이였어요?: They really were a dog and cat?
strings.이름이 같았나 봐. 진짜 감자는 감자같이 생겼고, 뭉치는 뭉치같이 생겼어: They must have had the same names. The real Potato looked like a potato, and Mungchi looked like a ball of fluff.
I'm so happy we got that much money just for finding a cat and dog.
strings.거기 아저씨도 돈 많이 버는 거 좋죠?: Mister, you like earning lots of money too, right?
%s, listen. For today, let's sweet-talk him into treating us to lots of good food.
Mister, I know some great restaurants in Glaston.
I'll have a quick word with %s, then lead the way.
strings.이야…. 말로만 듣던 글래스턴의 맛집을 가게 되다니, 시골 마을 마족이: Wow... To visit the famous Glaston restaurants I've only heard about. This country-village demon has come up in the world.
strings.아하하… 이래도 되나…. 어, 파르밀라?: Ahaha... Is this really all right...? Huh, Parmila?
strings.아, 맞다. 수고비. 이 정도면 괜찮지?: Oh, right. Your fee. Is this enough?
strings.고마워. 그러면 오늘은 회식이다! 알았지? 어디 가면 안 돼!!: Thank you. Today, we're having a company dinner! Understood? Don't go anywhere!!
strings.헤헤, 왜? 칼로네는 회식 싫어?: Hehe, what? Don't you like company dinners, Callone?
That's not it. If you're happy, Captain, then it's a good thing. Let's go.
A human company dinner... I'm deeply moved.
strings.아, 배고파…. 하아, 그런데 왠지 다음에도 이런 일이 또 일어날 것 같: Oh, I'm hungry... Sigh. Somehow, I feel something like this will happen again next time... It'll be all right, won't it?
